title: Complete Mappings of Semigroups
summary: A complete mapping of a semigroup $S$ is a bijection $α\colon S\to S$ such that the map $θ\colon S\to S$ defined by $xθ=x\cdot xα$ is also a bijection. Equivalently, it determines a transversal of the multiplication table of $S$. Complete mappings connect group theory, Latin squares, and cryptography, and their existence for finite groups was characterized by the resolution of the Hall--Paige conjecture.
